name: Income Tax e-Filing & Return (ITR)
description: Online filing of Income Tax Returns, PAN services, and tax payments by the Income Tax Department.
benefits: Legal compliance, refund claims, proof of income, easier loans/visa.
eligibility: Individuals/entities with taxable income or mandated filing (e.g., refund, foreign asset, high turnover).
fees: No government filing fee; late fees under Section 234F if delayed.
processing_time: Filing instant; refund within months of processing.
validity: Annual return for each financial year.
office_locator: Local Income Tax offices / Aaykar Sampark Kendras.
